text:
*The market is thinning as dusk approaches. Lanterns are being lit along the main streets, but the side alleys remain dark. You take stock of what you've learned.*

*Ashenmoor is a city under siege from within. Merchants are disappearing, ships arrive in secret, and the Merchants' Guild — led by the smiling Harren — seems to be at the center of it all. Meanwhile, the Duke lies ill and his steward, Goran, has been replacing loyal guards with hired swords.*

*The picture is incomplete. You need to dig deeper — but where?*

choices.text: Visit the Duke's estate and request an audience
Seek wisdom at the Temple of the Ashen God
Head back to the harbor to investigate at night
